notes: Simplify Library Lookup to one search bar and a clean alphabetical list of titles.
Search accepts either title text or an exact UPC/EAN, while UPC numbers are deliberately hidden from the collection list.
Open a title to see a compact popup of reliable relevant manifest information, with the full JSON available behind an optional View JSON expander.
Move Mass add UPCs and Check manifests into a single More tools popup, removing the cluttered tabs, filters and always-visible bulk import box.
